column1: # label<TAB>arxiv_clause   (category filter is appended by term-literature-count.sh)
# Concept-clustered version of terms.tsv. Each clause ORs the phrasings the
# literature actually uses for one failure mode, so arXiv dedups across synonyms
# in a single query. This corrects two problems in the single-term baseline:
#   - keyword noise (bare "narrativity", "side effects" matched unrelated work)
#   - undercount (one phrase misses synonyms, e.g. source fabrication)
# Read alongside terms.tsv, not instead of it: the single-term file shows how
# established each exact TERM is; this file shows how large each CONCEPT is.
